main_text.l: rum, uti est decreto Ordinum statutum;
de qua quotannis mense Februario in
rationes menstruas de iis, quæ ejus curæ
commissa sunt, apud hos eosdem red-
dit. Et licet etiam curatoribus adsciscerè
sibi matronas duas honestas rei œcono-
inspectionis in se recipiant, sed gratuitò
ἐργαστή-ριον[?] multis malis terrori, multis etiam

page.notes: The Greek word broken at the line end ("ἐργαστή-" / "ριον") is my reading from context (ergasterion, a house of correction); the letters are partly unclear, so the whole word is marked [?]. The large initial C of "CORONIS" is joined to the word as the drop cap. The faint "Digitized by Google" stamp at lower right is excluded.
